provenance: DIC-942 verified sample. Official column 「イチ推し！デッキ紹介」vol.10 (2026-07-31): player, placement, oshi/archetype and decklog code are published in the column prose; participant counts and full standings are not published by the source. Card lists are NOT carried here: Deck Log publishes complete lists behind POST /system/app/api/view/<code>, but its terms prohibit unauthorized reproduction, transmission, distribution and publication of site content, and that endpoint sends no CORS grant and X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow. Reachability is not permission (DIC-1001), so this repo stores and republishes none of it and every deck below stays non-importable, linking to Deck Log instead.
